info.title: Focus Assistant API
info.description: Session management and research data. Observed activity, heuristic estimates, and self-reports are separate.

get.summary: Summarize observed activity, estimates, goals, and self-reports in a date range.
get.description: Returns one aggregate bucket over a half-open range. An omitted range defaults to recent data. Reported ratings and heuristic state durations are distinct fields. Requires a Bearer access token. Owned resources are scoped to the authenticated account.

parameters.name: From
parameters.description: Inclusive ISO 8601 lower bound with UTC offset. Omit to use the endpoint default.

parameters.name: To
parameters.description: Exclusive ISO 8601 upper bound with UTC offset. If supplied with From, To must be later.

parameters.name: TimeZone
parameters.description: IANA reporting time zone, such as Europe/Kyiv or UTC. The default is UTC.

400.description: Correct malformed JSON, invalid field values or parameters. In production use HTTPS.

401.description: Log in again or use a current token. When changing credentials, verify the supplied password.

500.description: Retry later and give the request correlation ID to support if the failure persists.

get.summary: Return calendar day, ISO week, or month buckets in the requested IANA time zone.
get.description: Groups observed metrics by calendar day, ISO week or month in the requested IANA zone. Each bucket exposes UTC boundaries, including daylight-saving transitions. Requires a Bearer access token. Owned resources are scoped to the authenticated account.

parameters.description: UUID of the addressed work profile, owned by the authenticated account.

400.description: Correct malformed JSON, invalid field values or parameters. In production use HTTPS.

401.description: Log in again or use a current token. When changing credentials, verify the supplied password.

404.description: Check the addressed resource and account. Foreign resources are intentionally indistinguishable from missing ones.

500.description: Retry later and give the request correlation ID to support if the failure persists.

put.summary: Replace an owned work profile and its process rules.
put.description: Replaces settings and the complete set of rules for the addressed profile. Omitted rules are interpreted as an empty replacement. Requires a Bearer access token. Owned resources are scoped to the authenticated account.

delete.summary: Delete an unused profile. Sessions retain their profile references.
